body:
## Research findings

### 1. Machine and setup description

- **Put part-in-spindle mode on `SetupDef`, not on `machine::Kind`.** A Tormach 770MX (`assets/machines/tormach-770mx.mch`) is a `Kind::Mill` machine (`crates/post/src/machine/kind.rs`). One mill can run normal milling in one setup and part-in-spindle turning in another setup. Do not use `Kind::MillTurn`, which models live tooling on a lathe with a C axis.
- **Data needed on `SetupDef` (`crates/app/src/schema.rs`):**
  - A part-in-spindle mode block, valid only when the setup machine is `Kind::Mill` with X, Y, Z axes and a spindle.
  - `stock_tool_number` (for example `255` for `G43 H255`): the mill tool-table register for the stock length from spindle nose to stock face.
  - `collet_stickout_mm` and `collet_diameter_mm`: the collet nose sits at `Z = -collet_stickout_mm` in turning coordinates.
  - `workholding_max_rpm`: reuse `SetupDef::workholding_max_rpm` (`crates/app/src/setup_workholding.rs`), and make it mandatory in this mode.
  - A list of table tool stations. Each station maps one lathe tool to a unique 1-based work offset (`WorkOffset`), an approach side (`-X` or `+X` first; `-Y`/`+Y` later), a spindle direction (`M3` or `M4`), and an optional table position and block box for collision checks.
- **Work-offset limit:** `crates/post/src/post/work_offset.rs` already supports 1-based indices up to `MAX_BOUND = 255` (`crates/app/src/setup_offsets.rs::MAX_SLOT = 254`). `assets/posts/tormach.cps` supports offsets 1–9 (`G54`..`G59`, `G59.1`..`G59.3`) today, and `crates/app/src/posting_wcs_slot.rs` currently enforces one WCS per setup rather than per tool.

### 2. Operations, coordinate signs, CSS, and feed per revolution

- **Reuse the 12 turning operations and on-centre `Drill`.** `crates/motion/src/turning/profile.rs` generates turning CL in a `(station Z, radius R)` meridian frame with `+Z` at the free end and `-Z` toward the chuck. `crates/app/src/stock_sim_lathe.rs` simulates them about the fitted spindle axis.
- **Gate the operation families cleanly.** Update `Family::admits` (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`), `crates/app/src/posting_family.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/spindle_law.rs`, and `crates/app/src/lathe_voice.rs` so a `Kind::Mill` setup admits `Family::Turn` and on-centre `Drill` only when part-in-spindle mode is active, and refuses milling operations in that setup.
- **Mill mode is radius mode (`1:1`), not `G7` diameter mode.** LinuxCNC/PathPilot Mill mode has no `G7` diameter mode; `X` and `Y` command linear slide travel.
- **Z sign stays unchanged (`Z_mill = Z_turn`).** The workpiece hangs down from the mill spindle. Commanding `-Z` lowers the spindle and moves the stationary tool toward the collet, while `+Z` lifts the part away from the tool. Both negations cancel.
- **X sign and arc sense depend on the station side (ISO 841).** Programmed `X` moves the spindle (part) relative to the table (tool), so `x_tool_rel_part = -X_prog`:
  - A `-X` station (shank on `-X`, tip pointing `+X`) keeps `X_prog = +r` and standard `G18` `(I, K)` and `G2`/`G3` sense.
  - A `+X` station (shank on `+X`, tip pointing `-X`) mirrors to `X_prog = -r`, negates `I`, and swaps `G2` and `G3` (same mirror law as `crates/post/src/post/wcs_flip.rs`).
  - Apply nose control-point conversion (`crates/app/src/posting_nose.rs`, `crates/post/src/post/nose_tip.rs`, `crates/tools/src/orientation.rs`) in `(r, z)` before station mirroring.
- **Spindle direction (`M3` vs `M4`).** Viewed down the mill spindle (`-Z`), `M3` turns the part clockwise (same sense as a lathe viewed from chuck to free end). Under `M3`, the part surface moves toward `+Y` on the `-X` side and `-Y` on the `+X` side. Each station must declare `M3` or `M4` to match how its insert rake face mounts. For threading toward `-Z`, `M3` cuts a right-hand thread and `M4` cuts a left-hand thread on every side; refuse any mismatch between thread hand and station direction.
- **Fixed RPM (`G97` + `G94`) first; CSS (`G96`) and `G95` gated by encoder.** Per the LinuxCNC G-code reference (`G96`, `G95`, `G33`) and Tormach `UM10587` Ch. 10, `G96`, `G95`, and `G33` require spindle encoder feedback (`motion.spindle-speed-in`, present on MX servo spindles with `rigid_tapping: true`), and LinuxCNC `G96` measures radius only from active WCS `X0` (never `Y`). Start with fixed RPM (`S.. M3/M4` from `crates/app/src/cutting_turn.rs`) and `G94` (`F = frev * rpm`). Gate `G96` + `G95` behind spindle-encoder capability, X-axis stations only, and a mandatory `D` clamp.

### 3. Post structure

- **Use a dedicated post script (`assets/posts/tormach-mill-turn-spindle.cps`).** Keep `assets/posts/tormach.cps` and `assets/posts/tormach-lathe.cps` goldens unchanged. Declare a dedicated manifest flag (`partInSpindle = true`) and enforce it in `crates/app/src/posting_serves.rs` and `crates/app/src/lathe_voice.rs` so neither a plain mill post nor a `G7` lathe post can post a part-in-spindle setup.
- **Header and single `G43 H`:** Emit `G20`/`G21`, `G18`, `G90`, `G91.1`, `G94`, `G40`, `G49`, `G80`, and `G64 P`. Emit `G53 G0 Z<safe_retract>` then `G43 H<stock_tool_number>` once before the first cut. Never emit `M6` or `G49` between stations.
- **Safe station switches:** At the end of each section, retract radially clear of `StockTurnRadius`, retract axially to `ClearancePlane`, stop coolant (`M9`) and spindle (`M5`), and lift to `G53 G0 Z<safe_retract>`. Switch to the next station's work offset only at `G53 Z<safe_retract>`, rapid `X` and `Y0` at that height, start the spindle, and then lower `Z` to `ClearancePlane`.
- **Extended offsets:** Offsets 1–9 (`G54`..`G59`, `G59.1`..`G59.3`) work immediately from existing LinuxCNC rules. Verify PathPilot `G54.1 P1`..`P500` mapping on PathPilot Hub before widening `workOffsetMax` past 9.

### 4. Safety checks

- **Mandatory workholding RPM limit:** A 770MX mill spindle runs up to 10,000 RPM (`assets/machines/tormach-770mx.mch`). `crates/app/src/setup_workholding.rs::work_speed` currently skips `Kind::Mill` setups. For part-in-spindle setups, treat the mill spindle as the work spindle, require `workholding_max_rpm`, and block posting when it is unset or exceeded.
- **Collet nose and spindle body collisions:** Reuse `crates/app/src/operation/turning_holder_steel.rs` and `crates/tools/src/lathe_holder.rs` by modelling the collet nose (at `Z = -collet_stickout_mm`) and `Machine::spindle_d` as revolved steel that blocks posting with `Warning::FixtureHit`.
- **Adjacent gang tool blocks:** All table stations move together with the table. When station table positions and block boxes are stated, verify every rapid and feed move of the active station so no inactive station box contacts the swept envelope of the stock, part, collet nose, and spindle body. When positions are not stated, emit a named not-judged note (unstated-limit law).
- **Chip direction and stick-out:** Derive chip-throw direction from `(approach_side, spindle_dir)` (`+Y` away from operator or `-Y` toward operator) and print it on the setup sheet and in program comments. Add a non-blocking warning note when stock stick-out exceeds `3 * diameter` without tailstock support.

### 5. Public sources and RapidTurn distinction

- **RapidTurn docs are a different machine mode.** Tormach `UM10393` (RapidTurn Operator's Manual), `D32901` (PCNC 1100 layout drawing), and `TD10561` (1100M VFD kit) describe a horizontal 5C chucker headstock bolted to the mill table (3500 RPM high belt, 2000 RPM low belt or chuck). RapidTurn switches PathPilot into Lathe mode (`G7`, `G18`, `T0101`, no `G43`). Those docs apply to a future `Kind::Lathe` RapidTurn machine file, not vertical part-in-spindle Mill mode.
- **Primary public sources for vertical part-in-spindle turning on a 770MX:**
  - Tormach `UM10587` (770MX Operator's Manual, Ch. 10 Programming: PathPilot Mill G-codes, `G54.1 P1`..`P500`, `G18`, `G43 H`, `G53`, `G94`/`G95`, `G96`/`G97`, `G33`/`G76`).
  - LinuxCNC G-code Reference (`linuxcnc.org/docs/html/gcode/g-code.html`).
  - LinuxCNC Lathe User Information (`linuxcnc.org/docs/html/lathe/lathe-user.html` §§3, 4.2, 7.1).
  - RS-274 / ISO 6983 and ISO 841 coordinate conventions.
- **Items to verify on PathPilot Hub (770MX SIM) before air cuts:** `G43 H255` persistence across `G54`..`G59.3` switches, `G54.1 P` index mapping past 9, `G18` `G2`/`G3` backplot on `-X` and `+X` stations, and `G95`/`G96`/`G33` execution in Mill mode.

---

## Design proposal

Deliver the feature in five bounded slices.

1. **Smallest useful first slice (Slices 1 + 2 — #3406 and #3407):** Support part-in-spindle setup mode on `Kind::Mill` with `-X`/`+X` stations, `G54`..`G59.3`, mandatory `workholding_max_rpm`, fixed RPM (`G97` + `G94`), single `G43 H<stock>`, zero `M6` blocks, and `G53 G0 Z<safe_retract>` between stations. This slice already supports CamCraft stock simulation and PathPilot Hub dry runs for multi-tool facing, OD turning, grooving, parting, and on-centre drilling.
2. **Slice 3 (#3408):** Add blocking collision checks for the collet nose, spindle body, and neighbouring gang tool blocks on the table.
3. **Slice 4 (#3409):** Record PathPilot Hub readings and add gated `G54.1 P10`..`P255`, `G96` CSS + `G95` feed per rev, and `G33` threading for encoder-equipped mills.
4. **Slice 5 (#3410):** Add the Setups page station editor, chip-direction readout, and setup-sheet table.

---

## Filed sub-issues

1. **#3406 — Add part-in-spindle setup mode and table tool stations on mill machines** (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:turning`)
   Adds part-in-spindle mode, stock `H` register, collet geometry, and per-tool WCS stations to `SetupDef` with commands, MCP tools, turning admission, and mandatory `workholding_max_rpm`.
   Done means: undoable commands and MCP tools configure part-in-spindle mode and table stations on a `Kind::Mill` setup, project save and load preserve them, turning operations generate and simulate in `crates/app/src/stock_sim_lathe.rs`, milling operations and duplicate station offsets are refused by name, and an unset `workholding_max_rpm` blocks posting.

2. **#3407 — Add Tormach PathPilot part-in-spindle mill-turning post** (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
   Adds `assets/posts/tormach-mill-turn-spindle.cps` for PathPilot Mill-mode radius turning with one `G43 H`, no `M6`, per-tool WCS switches, `+X` mirroring, and `G53 G0 Z` retracts.
   Done means: golden `.nc` tests verify multi-tool facing, OD turning, grooving, parting, and on-centre drilling on `-X` and `+X` stations with exact `G18` `G2`/`G3` arc sense, one `G43 H`, zero `M6` blocks, and `G53 G0 Z` retracts between stations, and gate tests confirm that plain mill and `G7` lathe posts are refused on part-in-spindle setups.

3. **#3408 — Check collet nose and gang tool-block collisions in part-in-spindle turning** (`P6`, `effort:max`, `area:turning`)
   Models the collet nose, spindle body, and inactive table tool blocks in turning verification and blocks posting on any contact.
   Done means: verifier tests prove blocking `Warning::FixtureHit` findings for collet-nose strikes and neighbouring gang-block strikes, prove clear paths pass, and confirm the not-judged note when station positions are omitted.

4. **#3409 — Verify and gate PathPilot mill-mode G54.1 P, G95, G96 CSS, and G33 threading** (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
   Records PathPilot Hub 770MX SIM readings and adds gated `G54.1 P10`..`P255`, `G96`/`G95`, and `G33` threading with refusals for Y-axis `G96` and non-encoder mills.
   Done means: PathPilot Hub readings are recorded in the PR or decision file, golden `.nc` tests pin `G54.1 P`, gated `G96`/`G95`, and `G33` output, and refusal tests pin Y-axis `G96`, non-encoder machines, unclamped CSS, and mismatched thread hand.

5. **#3410 — Add Setups UI and setup sheet support for part-in-spindle turning** (`P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:turning`)
   Adds Setups page controls, chip-throw readout, and setup-sheet reporting for part-in-spindle setups and table tool stations.
   Done means: the Setups page edits part-in-spindle settings and stations through undoable commands, `crates/ui` structural and page-layout tests pass with no drop in test count, and the setup sheet includes the `G43 H` register, RPM cap, and every station's WCS, side, spindle direction, and chip direction.

Umbrella #2580 remains open for maintainer review.
Research complete: sub-issues #3406, #3407, #3408, #3409, #3410 (decisions in the comments above)
